ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, ultimate beneficial owners, and authorized signatories against the Bermuda Financial Policy Authority published sanctions notices, the UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, the United Nations Security Council consolidated sanctions list, the US OFAC SDN and non-SDN lists, and a reputable commercial database such as Dow Jones or World-Check. Any positive PEP determination, adverse media, or sanctions hit triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth verification, and, where warranted, a Suspicious Activity Report to the Financial Intelligence Agency before incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Bermuda Registry of Companies - Government e-Services / Corporate Registrar Online Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed name must be in the Latin script (English language). Non-Latin script names are not accepted for registration; where a preferred name is in another script, a statutory English transliteration must be submitted. The name must end in 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' for an exempted company; suffixes such as 'Corporation', 'Inc.', or 'Limited Liability Company' are not acceptable without enabling legislation. Hyphens and ampersands are permitted only where not misleading.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A written appeal against a name refusal must be lodged with the Registrar of Companies within 14 days of the refusal notification, accompanied by supporting evidence and the original refusal notice. The Registrar will reconsider the application and issue a definitive written decision. If the name reservation expires at the end of 30 days without extension, a fresh reservation application may be submitted. An extension may be requested before expiry, subject to the Registrar's discretion, for one further period of up to 30 days.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office alone is not legally permissible as the statutory registered office. The Companies Act 1981 requires an exempted company to maintain a physical registered office in Bermuda at a place open to the public, typically the registered agent's office. A virtual mailbox or supplementary service address may be used for operational convenience but cannot replace the statutory registered office obligation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated 5-10% annual probability) for a low-risk retail IoT hardware exempted company; however, the Registrar of Companies or the Bermuda Monetary Authority may conduct unannounced physical inspections if adverse regulatory signals arise, including odd AML filings, sanctions hits, or material inconsistencies in the economic substance declaration.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Act 1981 (Bermuda), ss. 4–5 (incorporation of exempted companies), s. 18 (registered office), s. 25 (register of members), s. 74 (officers); Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 (tax-exempt status); Business Licences Act 1990 (retail trading licence)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies and Insolvency Registry, Economic Development Department, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration as an Exempted Company together with the Memorandum of Association filed under s. 5(1) of the Companies Act 1981
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital prescribed by the Companies Act 1981; authorised share capital is fixed in the Memorandum at the board's discretion, may be denominated in any currency, and no escrow or capital deposit obligation applies
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that: (1) the share subscriptions set out in the Register of Members are accepted and the directors are authorised to allot and issue said common shares at par value for cash; (2) the office at the address notified by the Resident Representative is adopted as the Company's registered office for service of process under the Companies Act 1981; (3) the individuals named in the minute are appointed as first directors and as Chief Executive Officer and Corporate Secretary, with authority per the Bye-Laws; (4) the Bye-Laws are ratified, authorising bank and payment-account opening and execution of the Shopify and Stripe merchant agreements; (5) these minutes are recorded and certified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Incorporation Name Clearance and Registered Agent Appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Bermuda (via Bermuda-licensed law firm or registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct a Bermuda-licensed corporate services provider to conduct a name search and file a name-reservation request with the Registrar of Companies. Submit KYC/AML identification for each ultimate beneficial owner. The registered agent (resident representative) issues a formal engagement letter to be annexed to the incorporation file.
required_dossiers: Proposed exempted company name (reservation request)
Engagement letter of Bermuda law firm or licensed resident representative
AML/KYC pack: certified passport copy, proof of residential address and source of funds for each beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for similarity or prohibited character, file a fresh reservation with a modified distinctive element; re-clearance is issued within 2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Bermuda-licensed law firm and notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The law firm drafts the Memorandum of Association and Bye-Laws; the subscribers execute the documents and the first directors sign consents to act. Documents must be notarised only if foreign execution is required; otherwise, execution before a Bermuda witness is sufficient.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association (draft)
Bye-Laws (draft)
Consent to Act as Director form for each proposed director
KYC/AML due-diligence file on subscribers and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Registrar queries on constitutional clauses are cured by filing red-lined amendments to the Bye-Laws via the resident representative; no re-notarisation is required if amendments are confined to permitted variations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Government of Bermuda (electronic submission through resident representative)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The resident representative submits the signed Application for Registration as an Exempted Company, Memorandum of Association, Bye-Laws, statutory declaration, and registered-office consent, together with the government incorporation fee by bank transfer to the Accountant General.
required_dossiers: Application for Registration as an Exempted Company (s. 5(1) Companies Act 1981)
Signed Memorandum of Association and Bye-Laws
Statutory declaration of the resident representative
Consent of registered-office provider
Confirmation of government fee wire payment (BMD/USD)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for defective statutory declarations or fee shortfall, the resident representative files a corrective declaration and top-up payment; registration completes within 5 business days of cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Certificate of Incorporation Issuance and Registered Office Posting
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies and Insolvency Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation, formally posts the registered office address to the public registry, and returns the stamped Memorandum. The company is formed as a body corporate with limited liability.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (issued by Registrar)
Registered-office consent form (filed pre-incorporation)
Notice of first directors and officer addresses
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Deficient registered-office consent is cured by filing a fresh Form of Consent from an alternate licensed service provider; no re-payment of the incorporation fee is required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolution and Corporate Governance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the Exempted Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The first board meeting is held (in person, by telephone, or by written resolution) to ratify share subscriptions, adopt the registered office, appoint the first directors and officers, open bank and EMI accounts, and authorise execution of IoT retail platform agreements.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution (minutes or written resolution)
Register of Members (share ledger)
Register of Directors and Officers
Share certificates issued to subscribers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: No regulatory adverse action applies; any procedural irregularity in the initial governance acts is ratified by a unanimous written resolution of the directors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Business Licence and Post-Incorporation Statutory Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Business Licences, Ministry of Finance, Bermuda; Registrar of Companies for annual compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the Bermuda Business Licence in the Retail Trade category within sufficient time before trading commencement. File the licence application, attach the Certificate of Incorporation and exempted-company tax protection certificate, and declare expected gross receipts. Register for the annual economic substance and corporate service provider filings as applicable.
required_dossiers: Business Licence Application Form under the Business Licences Act 1990
Certified copy of Certificate of Incorporation
Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 certificate (if obtained)
Statement of expected gross receipts and business premises lease/ownership proof
Annual compliance calendar and registered-agent confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the licence application is objected to, submit supplementary evidence of the physical retail premises or amend the described trade category; appeal to the Board of Business Licences within 21 days of refusal.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Board of Business Licences, Ministry of Finance, Government of Bermuda
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Bermuda Business Licence – Retail Trade (Specialty IoT and Consumer Electronics Store) category under the Business Licences Act 1990

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR), Government of Bermuda
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – No EIA required; retail sale and warehousing of smart-home IoT consumer devices is not a 'prescribed undertaking' under the Development and Planning Act 1974 and Environmental Impact Assessment Regulations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for pure retail (no point-source manufacturing): zero process wastewater and no VOC-emission threshold; packaging waste to be segregated per the national Solid Waste Management Policy; defective-device e-waste must be consigned to a registered recycler and, if exported, must comply with the Basel Convention transboundary movement procedure.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Bermuda Fire and Rescue Service (annual inspection); building/shop occupancy permit from the Development Applications Board confirming structural load capacity and means of egress; workplace clearance under the Occupational Safety and Health Act 1982 with employer liability insurance per the Workmen's Compensation Act 1965; electrical safety verification of demo IoT units under the Electricity Supply Act standards.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Bermuda Ministry of Finance - Office of the Tax Commissioner (payroll and miscellaneous taxes) and the Bermuda Registrar of Companies (incorporation registry). Official portal: https://www.gov.bm
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities form a Bermuda Exempted Company by registering with the Registrar of Companies; the Certificate of Incorporation number serves as the statutory company identifier. No separate income tax TIN is issued because Bermuda levies no corporate income tax. If the company has Bermuda-sourced employees, it must register as an employer with the Office of the Tax Commissioner to obtain a payroll tax account number. For customs transactions, importers/exporters must engage a licensed customs broker and register with the Bermuda Customs Department. No VAT ID is obtainable or required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Bermuda has no domestic check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election mechanism. A Bermuda Exempted Company automatically qualifies for tax exemption under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 (protection from future Bermuda taxes until 2035). It may voluntarily elect to file economic substance returns if the relevant activity is undertaken, and it may make foreign entity classifications (e.g., US Form 8832 check-the-box) for tax purposes in jurisdictions that permit such elections.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No national VAT/GST/Sales Tax; Bermuda applies customs duties on imports and stamp duty on certain instruments
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable - no indirect tax registration threshold exists. Entities importing goods into Bermuda must submit customs declarations and a customs broker account is required for each import entry; no VAT threshold is prescribed.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, electronic invoicing, API stamping, or digital signature mandate exists. Commercial invoices are governed by general commercial law. Import and export declarations are lodged through the Bermuda Customs online automated system (Bermuda Automated Customs System) without fiscal stamping.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable - Bermuda operates no VAT/GST regime, so no export zero-rating claim mechanism exists. Goods exported from Bermuda are exempt from any Bermuda indirect tax by default, and no refundable input tax arises for exporters.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bermuda Customs Export Entry (electronic/paper C1 declaration)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Export Permit or License (only for controlled or prohibited goods)
Inward Remittance Certificate (only where a payment instrument is used for customs valuation)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT refund or export zero-rating clawback regime applies in Bermuda. However, customs fraud (false declarations, understatement of value, misdescription) is penalised under the Customs Act 2003 with fines up to BMD 50,000 and/or imprisonment up to two years, together with potential forfeiture of goods. A Bermuda Exempted Company that breaches economic substance requirements may be liable for penalties up to BMD 100,000, and the Registrar of Companies may strike the company off the register, resulting in loss of limited liability and tax-exempt status.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Bermuda Monetary Authority (BMA), acting as the Exchange Control Authority under the Exchange Control Act 1972 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1973, with supervisory jurisdiction over all domestic authorized banks and currency issuance for the Bermuda Dollar (BMD), which is pegged at 1:1 to the United States Dollar.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The BMA operates a fully liberalized current account and a substantially deregulated capital account. A Bermuda Exempted Company designated as 'non-resident' under the Exchange Control regime enjoys full currency convertibility, holds and settles in USD, BMD, GBP, and EUR without transaction-level BMA approval, and benefits from a blanket General Permission for ongoing treasury flows. Dividend remittance, interest payments, and capital repatriation to the UK parent are unrestricted in law and are not subject to Bermudian withholding taxes. The residual practical hurdle is documentary: authorized banks must file exchange control returns with the BMA on share subscriptions and any inward remittance exceeding USD 100,000, and will require the company's certificate of non-resident status to be produced at account opening. The BMD peg to USD, combined with US Dollar legal-tender equivalence in the local market, effectively eliminates USD/BMD conversion friction and narrows the treasury FX focus to GBP and EUR exposures generated by consumer payments from Stripe and Shopify.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Bermuda imposes no statutory surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio on export proceeds. The Exchange Control General Permission regime exempts non-resident Exempted Companies from any duty to convert foreign-currency export receipts into BMD; all proceeds from the cross-border retail sale of smart IoT hardware may be retained indefinitely in USD, GBP, or EUR in offshore or onshore accounts. Authorized banks are required to submit aggregate monthly exchange control statistics to the BMA, but individual transaction reporting is limited to inward capital subscriptions rather than trade receivables, and no timeframe exists within which export receipts must be repatriated or exchanged.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: The Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-Low. Bermuda maintains no Electronic Money Institution licensing framework; the Digital Asset Business Act 2018 covers only digital-asset custodians and exchanges. Offshore UK/FCA-regulated EMIs and US Money Transmitter platforms (Wise, Airwallex, Currencycloud) are legally usable in Bermuda solely as supplementary settlement conduits for aggregating Stripe and Shopify Payments receipts, but they are not permitted to establish a Bermudian branch, hold BMD, or provide local debit/clearing infrastructure. A Bermudian Tier-1 bank will treat an EMI flood-in transfer as an unregulated third-party remittance, triggering enhanced due diligence, longer holding periods, and a de-risking review if EMI-sourced volume exceeds 30% of annual treasury throughput. Primary operating liquidity must remain in a licensed Bermudian bank to satisfy solvency look-through tests applied by the auditors and the BMA.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is materially mandated as the default standard: Butterfield and HSBC Bermuda require at least one director or an expressly authorized signatory to attend an in-person KYC and beneficial-ownership interview at the bank's Hamilton office before an account is activated. Remote onboarding is available only on a discretionary basis where the beneficial owner already holds a Prime-tier relationship with an HSBC or Butterfield group entity in the UK, and where the Bermuda corporate records are apostilled, the directors' passports are notarized by a UK solicitor, and the incorporating agent co-signs the corporate introduction. Even with a complete remote package, the bank's compliance committee retains the right to compel attendance; below a director interview, the formation agent's nominee director may stand in only for account maintenance sign-off, not for the initial risk-acceptance interview.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore Bermudian Exempted Company with no local economic footprint, 100% UK beneficial ownership, and remote foreign-resident directors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, Companies House register extract of the UK parent, notarized passports and dual-source proof of address of all directors and ultimate beneficial owners, signed register of directors and officers, registered office certificate and corporate secretary engagement letter, substance-attestation resolution confirming the non-resident designation, and a letter of introduction from the Bermudian registered agent on their regulated letterhead.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity e-commerce settlement flow with daily Stripe and Shopify payout credits, including aggregated third-party consumer remittances and frequent same-value-day credits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed merchant services agreement with Stripe Payments Europe UAB and the Shopify Payments merchant contract, six months of platform settlement statements, reconciled payout-lag report evidencing T+2 settlement, customer refund and chargeback policy documentation, returns and dispute resolution logs, and supplier purchase invoices mapping inbound treasury credits to IoT hardware inventory acquisition.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-face-to-face digital identity verification of ultimate beneficial owners located in the United Kingdom
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Digital identity verification report with liveness detection (Onfido or IDnow), UK driving licence and passport dual-source verification, 3-month UK bank statement, sanctions and PEP screening results issued within 30 days, and a signed UK parent bank reference confirming the beneficial owner's existing prime-tier relationship and clean conduct record.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ambiguity between inbound share-subscription capital from the UK parent and intercompany debt funding, creating mix ambiguity that triggers exchange-control filing requirements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed share-subscription agreement and board resolution authorizing issuance, formal intercompany loan agreement with arm's-length interest-rate justification supported by transfer-pricing documentation, UK parent board minutes approving the inward remittance, SWIFT MT103 reference fields pre-coded as 'EQUITY CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION' or 'INTERCOMPANY LOAN', and the BMA exchange-control notification form for non-resident share issues submitted through the bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The UK parent wires USD from its HSBC UK corporate account via SWIFT MT103 to the Bermuda Exempted Company's USD account at HSBC Bank Bermuda Limited, using beneficiary BIC and account reference 'BM_EXEMPTED_CO_ISIC4791'. The remittance information block must contain: (i) ISO 20022 purpose code 'SCNR' (Securities, Capital Raising) for equity subscriptions or 'DVPM' for intercompany loans; (ii) beneficiary reference 'BM_EXEMPTED_CO_SHARE_ISSUE_2024'; (iii) narrative referencing the Companies Act 1981 section 8A allotment and share certificate number; and (iv) the annotation 'NON-RESIDENT GENERAL PERMISSION - NO PRIOR BMA CLEARANCE REQUIRED'. Verification protocol: HSBC Bermuda will place the funds in a Capital Escrow Account pending presentation of the board-allotment resolution, stamped share certificate, updated register of members, and the BMA exchange-control acknowledgement filed through the bank; upon registration of the allotment with the Registrar of Companies, funds are released to the operational account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rail: SWIFT MT103 for supplier settlements to Shenzhen and Hong Kong IoT OEM/ODM manufacturers, with remittance fields coded as 'PROCEEDS OF GOODS' and referencing the commercial invoice number, Incoterms 2020 rule, and purchase order ID; standard terms are 30% advance with 70% against bill of lading. Secondary rail: Commercial Letters of Credit issued via SWIFT MT700 by HSBC Bermuda in favour of Asian suppliers for purchase orders above USD 250,000, with the required documentation set of commercial invoice, full-set clean on-board bill of lading, packing list, certificate of origin, and inspection certificate. Consumer-facing collections: Stripe UAB and Shopify Payments sweep daily EUR, GBP, and USD card balances through aggregated bank-transfer settlement directly into the Butterfield USD operational account, achieving T+2 intraday liquidity confirmation; lag accounts and provisional-credit risk are mitigated by a rolling 5-day cash buffer of the prior month's average daily settlement. Domestic Bermuda operational disbursements for warehousing, logistics, and administrator fees clear through Butterfield's online banking in BMD, which settles at par with USD on the same day.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla deliverable FX forwards (tenor 1-12 months) in USD/EUR and USD/GBP executed with HSBC Bermuda or Butterfield's treasury desk, collateralized by the operational account balance and documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with a Bermuda-law governed Credit Support Annex

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing USD/EUR and USD/GBP where the company elects BMD as functional currency, eliminating the BMD deliverability constraint and settling in US Dollars on Bermuda Business Days

Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (USD/EUR and USD/GBP) to reprice the intercompany loan from the UK parent, converting floating-rate USD principal and interest into fixed-rate operating currency liabilities
European-style FX options on USD/GBP with a capped premium structure (zero-cost collars) to protect the retail margin on UK domestic smart-home product sales against adverse sterling depreciation

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a standard Bermuda exempted company; 15% for constituent entities of in-scope MNE groups with consolidated group revenue of at least EUR 750,000,000 in at least 2 of the 4 preceding accounting periods
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holidays or preferential corporate income tax deductions are available to standard exempted companies. Where Bermuda corporate income tax applies, the effective rate is mitigated by the substance-based income exclusion on qualifying payroll and tangible assets, plus foreign tax credit relief for foreign-source dividends, interest, royalties, and branch profits.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Eligibility Return (Form ELIG-01) filed electronically through the Bermuda Tax e-Filing portal operated by the Office of the Tax Commissioner
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: One-off initial filing, with updated filings required upon a material change in group composition, revenue, or Bermuda presence
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Prescribed by Notice to File under the Tax Administration Act 2023; for existing entities the initial return is generally due within 12 months after the start of the relevant accounting period, and for newly incorporated exempted companies within 30 days of incorporation or such later date as the Commissioner allows

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name, Bermuda Business Number, registered office, incorporation date, and legal form of the Bermuda exempted company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact legal name in the Bermuda Register; attach the Certificate of Incorporation and list the local authorised representative.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of the ultimate parent entity, jurisdictional tax residence, and global MNE group entity ownership chart.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident owned exempted company must identify the non-Bermuda ultimate parent and certify that decisions are not taken by shareholders in Bermuda unless management and control is actually exercised there.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Group consolidated revenue test: whether the MNE group generated EUR 750,000,000 or more in consolidated revenue in at least 2 of the 4 preceding fiscal periods.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Do not exclude retail sales processed through Stripe or Shopify Payments from the revenue test; all group consolidated revenue in all jurisdictions is counted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of whether the Bermuda entity is excluded or exempted under any transitional or de minimis provision of the Corporate Income Tax Act 2023.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident entity that is not part of an in-scope MNE group should affirm the nil scope declaration; retained records must evidence the revenue computation for at least six years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file an Eligibility Return or filing a knowingly false declaration is treated as a tax compliance default under the Tax Administration Act 2023, triggering a fixed penalty, a daily default surcharge, and interest at the statutory rate. Deliberate misdeclaration can be prosecuted as tax evasion with fines and imprisonment.
